calls.title: Nikhita and Graham McNicoll
calls.summary: The meeting focused on resolving critical access issues to enhance data tracking and analytics management. Admin rights were granted to Nikhita for Growth Hook, allowing for improved feature usage and campaign tracking. Nikhita also confirmed her access to Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics, ensuring necessary platforms for unified data collection. A decision was made to postpone the meeting due to Graham's absence, with Nikhita taking charge of rescheduling. The team acknowledged the use of Fireflies AI for automatic note-taking, ensuring that meetings are documented even with partial attendance. Clear roles were emphasized, with Nishant delegating responsibilities to Nikhita during his unavailability and Nikhita committing to follow up on participant attendance to maintain communication efficiency.
calls.keywords: Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics, Growth Hook, admin access, meeting rescheduling, participant absence

calls.title: Nikhita and Graham McNicoll
calls.summary: The team discussed steps to improve debugging efforts by transitioning to autonomous debugging using AI tools like Gemini and Claude. Nishant directed Nikhita to explore multiple alternative solutions after documentation proved inadequate. Additionally, the group decided to minimize dependence on Graham, who was deemed unreliable, reminding the team to continue independent debugging to expedite problem resolution. Nikhita was tasked with compiling detailed context and tracking events related to the Growth Book SDK to better understand the underlying issues. To facilitate team availability, meetings were rescheduled to allow for optimal collaboration and asynchronous support from Nishant after hours.
calls.keywords: Growth Book SDK, Gemini research, debugging, Claude AI, escalation, meeting rescheduling
